## 当前激活的 MCP 配置（2026-04-24 起）

`C:\Users\majq1\.claude\.mcp.json` 里 `redmine` 条目走 **stdio + uvx + runekaagaard/mcp-redmine**：

```json

  "command": "C:\\Users\\majq1\\AppData\\Local\\Packages\\PythonSoftwareFoundation.Python.3.13_qbz5n2kfra8p0\\LocalCache\\local-packages\\Python313\\Scripts\\uvx.exe",
  "args": ["--index-url","https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/","--from","mcp-redmine","--refresh-package","mcp-redmine","mcp-redmine"],
```
